by: the merge core's determinism and idempotency checks
the provenance log, which records every version and the evidence behind it
check.population: every delta applied to the profile
check.freshness: a verdict stands until a new turn produces evidence or the frozen baseline changes
check.refusal: a delta without same-turn evidence is rejected, and the fallback mirror accepts no writes
check.observation: the provenance log, which locates when and from what evidence each fact entered
check.evidence: none: the catalog states this check as a class, so a watched run belongs to each system that adopts it
check.authority: the same-turn evidence, which every delta cites, and the frozen baseline, which the mirror never overrides

records.title: Profile Compose

exemplar.before: Accumulated profile knowledge treated as ground truth, never re-verified.
exemplar.after: profile store → read doc (or empty) → strip volatile metadata → compact view → injected as disclosed memory, reverifiable against source

records.intent: Specializing the RAG Knowledge Boundary, read the durable profile document (or an empty one), strip volatile metadata, and project a compact view injected into reasoning as retrieved memory rather than ground truth.
records.invariant: Accumulated knowledge is disclosed as supported evidence, not authority; the consumer still grounds every use against live source.

records.title: Delta Capture

exemplar.before: A speculative claim written into durable memory without same-turn evidence.
exemplar.after: structured turn → knowledge delta → keep only facts verified this turn → admissible delta; unverified rejected

records.intent: Specializing the RAG Knowledge Boundary, accept a structured knowledge delta the reasoning turn self-reports inline, admit only facts verified within that same turn, and reject speculation without a separate extraction pass.
records.invariant: A durable fact enters the profile only from evidence produced in the same turn; unsupported claims are rejected, never guessed into memory.

records.title: Idempotent Merge

exemplar.before: Re-applying the same delta grows an axis and changes the document.
exemplar.after: doc + delta → stable fact identity → per-field-kind merge{overwrite | union | append-dedupe-cap} → double-apply is a no-op

records.intent: Specializing the Idempotent Side Effect, assign each fact a stable identity, apply the delta per field kind, deduplicate and cap, and guarantee that re-applying the same delta yields the same document.
records.invariant: Merge is idempotent and bounded — the same delta applied twice is a no-op, and no axis grows without limit.

records.title: Version Provenance

exemplar.before: A version bumped and mutated in place even on a no-op merge.
exemplar.after: merged doc → change detect → {no-op: untouched | real change: bump + timestamp + modification record}

records.intent: Specializing Governance Evolution, detect whether the merge changed state, and only on real change bump the version, timestamp it, and append a modification record — leaving a no-op untouched.
records.invariant: A no-op delta bumps nothing; every real change is auditable and reversible, and a version is never mutated in place without a provenance record.

records.title: Deterministic Merge Core

exemplar.before: Merge reads the wall clock internally, so identical inputs differ.
exemplar.after: (doc, delta, injected clock) → pure merge → (doc', modification|null); no hidden time/state/randomness

records.intent: Specializing the Deterministic Core, keep compose and merge pure functions over immutable inputs with the clock injected, so identical inputs reproduce identical outputs.
records.invariant: No hidden time, state, or randomness — the clock is a parameter, and merge is referentially transparent.

records.title: Persistence Fork

exemplar.before: Accumulation written to a fallback mirror, creating a divergent source of truth.
exemplar.after: connection mode → {trusted arm connected: authoritative per-owner store, write back | disconnected: read-only mirror}

records.intent: Specializing the Port Adapter, resolve the durable store by connection mode — an authoritative per-owner store when the trusted arm is connected, a read-only mirror otherwise — and write back only where accumulation is trusted.
records.invariant: Authoritative accumulation happens only against the trusted store; the fallback is a read mirror, never a divergent source of truth.

records.title: Seed Composition

exemplar.before: Accumulated knowledge merged into the baseline, rewriting frozen scope.
exemplar.after: frozen baseline + composed knowledge → additive overlay (baseline immutable) → turn seed

records.intent: Specializing Canonical Data, overlay the accumulated knowledge onto the frozen baseline scope as additive context without mutating the baseline.
records.invariant: The frozen baseline is an immutable source of truth; accumulated knowledge is additive context, never a rewrite of scope.

records.title: Living Profile Kernel

exemplar.before: Per-turn evidence written to memory ungated, unbounded, unversioned.
exemplar.after: compose → seed → turn → capture verified delta → idempotent merge (injected clock) → version only real change → persist against the fork → loop

records.intent: Compose the accumulated knowledge onto the frozen baseline into a seed, run the reasoning turn, capture the inline verified delta, merge it idempotently under an injected clock, version only real change, and persist against the fork — looping per turn.
records.invariant: A living profile is a versioned, idempotently accumulated, provenance-logged memory that grows only from verified per-turn evidence and never overrides frozen scope or live source.

records.title: <Living Accumulation Concern>
records.intent: <Compose prior memory as disclosed evidence> → <Capture only same-turn verified deltas> → <Merge idempotently by stable identity, bounded> → <Version and log only real change> → <Persist against the connection fork> → <Overlay onto the immutable baseline>
records.invariant: Any per-turn evidence stream becomes durable memory only when accumulation is idempotent, bounded, provenance-logged, deterministic at its core, and additive to an immutable baseline it may never rewrite.
